max.label: No-compromise quality
max.description: Frontier reasoning for architecture, long-horizon execution, and independent verification.
notes: Fable 5 is not shown as ZDR-eligible by Cursor; review your data-retention requirements before use.

hybrid.label: Balanced multi-vendor default
hybrid.description: Premium planning, Kimi execution, economical research, and an independent OpenAI verification path.

value.label: Best performance per dollar
value.description: Cursor Grok for high-leverage reasoning, Terra for execution, and Composer for volume work.
notes: Cursor reports that Grok 4.5 may have an unknown CursorBench advantage from older Cursor repository data in training.

budget.label: Low-cost daily work
budget.description: GLM planning, Composer execution, Luna research, and targeted Gemini use for UI/AI research.

frontier.label: Cursor-native frontier
frontier.description: Only Cursor models: Grok 4.5 for deep and fast work, Composer 2.5 for the Sonnet tier and mapping/synthesis.
notes: Fast variants trade higher token prices for lower latency.

openweight.label: Kimi + GLM open-weight stack
openweight.description: Kimi for long-horizon planning and coding, with GLM as an independent verification path.
notes: Open-weight describes model availability, not local execution; Cursor still hosts and routes these models.

provenance.catalog: Validated against the signed-in Cursor CLI model catalog (`agent --list-models`) on 2026-07-29.
provenance.benchmark: Profile design informed by CursorBench 3.2; small score differences may not be statistically significant.
provenance.surface: These profiles target Cursor Desktop and Cursor CLI. Cursor Cloud Agents can expose a smaller model subset.
provenance.account: Availability can vary by Cursor plan, organization policy, region, and model-catalog changes. Run `gsd-cursor doctor` locally before use.
